scope: Vulkan RoPE compute kernel correctness against a CPU reference that replicates MGRope::Alpha() from ModelGenieExecutor.cpp exactly, including the YaRN corr_dim bounds and rope_yarn_ramp mix.
what_was_replaced: VulkanCompute::ExecuteRoPE was a placeholder that printed a message and returned true without performing any work. It now dispatches a real compute shader.

implementation.supporting: VulkanCompute::EnsureRoPEPipeline in src/vulkan_compute.cpp; rope descriptor layout/pool members in include/vulkan_compute.h
implementation.device: AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700, compute queue family 0
implementation.parameters: Defaults to the DeepSeek-V2-Lite configuration: freq_base 10000, freq_scale 0.025, original_context_length 4096, beta_fast 32, beta_slow 1. yarn_log_multiplier is accepted conceptually but unused because attn_factor_org == rope_attn_factor == 1, so mscale == 1 and no cos/sin magnitude scaling is required.
implementation.note_on_signature: ExecuteRoPE keeps its original host-pointer signature, so the current kernel does a host upload and readback per call. That is correct but not optimal; a deeper integration can keep vectors device-resident.

notes: dim 64 / rot 64 is the exact Deep2 K_pe shape, so the previously-verified native K_PE comparison against the llama.cpp reference is now backed by a real GPU kernel.
dim 128 / rot 64 and dim 192 / rot 64 confirm dimensions beyond the rotated range pass through unchanged.
dim 66 exercises the odd trailing element copy path.
pos 0 yields exactly zero difference, confirming rotation at position 0 is the identity as expected.
what_this_does_not_establish: Deep2 Layer 0 GPU inference. ModelGenieExecutor still performs its attention and linear arithmetic on the CPU; this kernel is available but not yet called by the inference path.
GPU quantised linear projections (Q4_K / Q6_K). The existing matmul kernel is plain FP32 and does not consume quantised weights.
